idea: Retest the strongest current liquid alert-edge B-tier bucket: XRP 4h range breakout long in an up/mid-vol regime.

thesis.mechanism: The liquid alert-edge backtest currently shows XRP 4h range_breakout_long in up/mid-vol as the strongest B-tier bucket, suggesting participation-backed breakouts may persist when symbol, timeframe, and regime align.
thesis.expectedBehavior: XRP 4h up/mid-vol long breakouts should keep positive expectancy, beat a matched timestamp baseline, and survive out-of-sample after fees and slippage.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if the alert-edge bucket does not survive the stricter destruction filter, especially out-of-sample, baseline lift, drawdown, and walk-forward stability.

idea: Retest the cleanest local volume-velocity feedback bucket: ETH 60s DOWN alerts with 5/5 evidence and fresh public book state, where finalized reviews all favored a fade.

thesis.mechanism: Clean ETH velocity-down alerts with high evidence may mark short-term exhaustion when the move is already crowded and public book/trade-flow evidence is fresh.
thesis.expectedBehavior: A coarse ETH 1h OHLCV proxy for high-volume down shocks should produce positive contrarian expectancy, beat matched timestamps, and survive out-of-sample after costs.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if the historical proxy cannot survive strict gates; also reject any promotion claim because the source alert bucket has only four clean finalized reviews and 60s row-level shocks are not fully reconstructed from hourly candles.

idea: Trade breakouts only when price clears the recent range with above-normal volume.

thesis.mechanism: Breakouts can persist when range compression resolves with above-normal participation.
thesis.expectedBehavior: Signal direction should outperform a time-matched alternating-direction baseline after costs.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if breakout direction does not add expectancy versus matched timestamps or fails out-of-sample.

idea: Fade sharp exhaustion moves when RSI is stretched and the market is not in strong trend expansion.

thesis.mechanism: Sharp stretched candles can mean-revert when RSI is extended and broader trend strength is muted.
thesis.expectedBehavior: Contrarian direction should beat price-only timing after fees and slippage.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if stretched RSI buckets are not better than baseline or break in strong adverse regimes.

idea: Follow the dominant moving-average regime after a pullback reclaims the fast average.

thesis.mechanism: A fast moving-average reclaim inside a dominant regime can mark continuation after a pullback.
thesis.expectedBehavior: Regime-continuation entries should survive across symbols and avoid low-quality range slices.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if continuation signals depend on one market slice or fail the chronological out-of-sample split.

idea: Fade crowded perp moves when funding is stretched, open interest expands, and RSI is extended.

thesis.mechanism: Stretched funding plus expanding open interest can mark crowded perp positioning vulnerable to a fade.
thesis.expectedBehavior: Crowded positive funding should favor short fades and crowded negative funding should favor long fades after costs.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if funding/OI conditions only work in-sample or do not beat price-only and matched-timestamp baselines.

idea: Fade HYPE perp moves when funding is stretched and RSI confirms positioning stress, without requiring open-interest expansion.

thesis.mechanism: Stretched funding can mark one-sided perp positioning vulnerable to mean reversion even when open-interest change is not elevated.
thesis.expectedBehavior: High positive funding should favor short fades and negative funding should favor long fades after costs.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if funding-only fades fail chronological out-of-sample, matched baseline, deflated-Sharpe, or failure-slice gates.

idea: Fade stretched HYPE funding only inside one explicit market trend regime to test whether funding edge is regime-dependent.

thesis.mechanism: Funding-only fades may have positive expectancy in specific trend regimes while failing in range or adverse-trend slices.
thesis.expectedBehavior: A single trend-regime filter should improve out-of-sample expectancy and reduce worst-slice failures versus funding-only fade.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if trend-filtered funding fades still fail out-of-sample, drawdown, failure-slice, or matched-baseline gates.

idea: Fade stretched HYPE funding only on one timeframe and one trend regime after trend-filter results suggested 4h/range slices may be unstable.

thesis.mechanism: Funding fade expectancy may live in a narrow intraday regime; timeframe filtering should remove incompatible 4h failure slices if the effect is real.
thesis.expectedBehavior: The 1h trend-filtered variant should keep positive expectancy while improving out-of-sample and drawdown versus all-timeframe funding fade.
thesis.falsifiableClaim: Reject if the 1h/timeframe-filtered variant still fails out-of-sample or only improves in-sample headline metrics.
